verdict.rationale: Notion's AI features are referenced (instant answers with citations, agents), but nothing shows the in-app assistant learning a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences to tailor its output. The closest item, Notion Skills (instruction pages for repeatable workflows, documented under MCP guides), is an adjacent user-maintained instruction mechanism, not personalization learning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
